title: ENSO/IOD driver indices, seasonal
source: NOAA CPC; NOAA PSL; NOAA NCEI ERSSTv6 calculated supplement
citation: NOAA Climate Prediction Center; NOAA Physical Sciences Laboratory; NOAA NCEI ERSSTv6 (Huang et al., 2025); HadISST, Met Office Hadley Centre.
method: enso_drivers_build.py preserves DMI_CPC published history. DMI_ERSST6 supplements only missing months using NCEI ERSSTv6 SST minus fixed PSL 1991–2020 climatology, clipped spherical cell areas over west 50–70E/10S–10N minus east 90–110E/10S–0. Calculated rows are explicitly labelled, provisional and independently reproduced from _sources/DMI_ERSST6.inputs.npz; receipt records source hashes, April discrepancy and recent grid revisions. Seasonal values are 3-month means, labelled calculated if any component is calculated.
used_by: notebook §7 outlook analogue matching + driver context

index.description: Product identifier; DMI_ERSST6 preserves CPC history and adds calculated missing months
